decisions.reason: Operator training draws directly on the firm's application know-how and training capabilities, supports machine sales, and feeds customer learning back into product development.
A fourth rotary axis is a modular accessory that builds closely on the firm's core milling machines and is easy to interpret and refine with existing engineering knowledge.

Hybrid additive post-processing sits further from the firm's established knowledge base, but it fits the stated push into future-oriented materials processing and can be improved through in-house R&D and testing.
The high-speed CNC milling line is the firm's core competence, with several models backed by a sizable R&D team and a global service network.
Automatic tool change complements the milling machines directly and relies on the firm's modular engineering and tooling expertise.
